style: factual clickbait for China finance audience

data_driven_lessons.source: KC桌面-视频号动态数据明细.csv, 114 rows, July 2026 local analysis
winning_patterns: 机构/人物权威 + 具体数字/资产 + 强问题，例如 高盛王逸：4-5万亿城市更新会拖住楼市吗
大机构/名人 + 被逼/陷阱/真相/转向 等张力词，例如 野村辜朝明：日本央行被逼到墙角
具体数据 + 政策动作疑问，例如 6月PMI释放积极信号，政府会加码吗
反常识判断 + 下一步条件，例如 低估值可能是价值陷阱，需等待政策转向消费
中国相关议题更容易获得点击，但表达要落在政策、需求、信心、估值、产业升级这些正向框架
外资或海外权威给出对中国更积极的判断时，反差本身就是主标题，不要埋在摘要里
让观众产生单一强反应：居然如此、终于有人说、他说的是真的吗、原来中国优势在这里
大实话角度来自表达者身份与观点反差；言行反差角度必须有公开动作或披露支撑
涉及中国比较优势时，优先把外国企业被迫调整、海外权威改口或中国优势被低估写成冲突
avoid_patterns: 过长的新闻句，尤其是 24 字以上还塞多个从句
只有 策略/机会/影响/前瞻/市场/风险 这类泛词，没有具体对象或张力
美国宏观泛标题如果没有美联储/鲍威尔等强锚点，点击明显弱
纯描述式标题，例如 某市场短期风险与长期催化剂，缺少问题和冲突
经济危机/金融危机/崩盘/崩溃 这类过硬负面财经词
把事实换成疑问号但没有反差，例如 回报路径在哪、未来如何、能否实现
陌生英文人名或机构全称占据第一行，却没有告诉观众这个人为什么值得听
把 Bloomberg LP 等来源或公司法律后缀误当成采访对象
没有公开证据却暗示嘉宾撒谎、操纵或言行不一

briefs.speaker: Laetitia Garnier
briefs.speaker_context: CEO of H&H Group (Health and Happiness)
briefs.current_title: H&H集团CEO：十年健康战略，中国婴配粉逆势增长58%

subtitles.zh: 有趣的是，在宏观环境下中国业务表现突出。您认为是什么让您的业务对当前消费疲软更具韧性？
subtitles.en: Yeah, it's interesting that China stood out given the macro conditions. What makes it, I guess, you're trying to business a bit more resilient to sort of the consumption weakness that we're seeing in the economy now?

subtitles.zh: 我认为是我们近10年前实施的战略，专注于健康与 wellness。我们几乎将所有品牌，三大核心品牌，都聚焦于此。
subtitles.en: I think the strategy that we implemented almost 10 years ago that was focusing on to health and wellness. We have almost focused all of our brands, our three macro brands, which is biostimes, where disaster was.

subtitles.zh: 我们相信这是关键因素。我们持续投入科学研发。特别是婴幼儿配方奶粉业务，之所以能快速表现，是因为我们贴近市场并持续创新。
subtitles.en: We believe that is the key underlining factor for us, right? We continue to invest in science and to all of men. If you look at in particular for our infant will formula business, the reason we have able to perform so fast is because of a s

subtitles.zh: 我们最大的突破是推出了HMO产品。我们是唯一在中国市场推出该产品的进口品牌，这推动了我们的终端消费。
subtitles.en: Our biggest disruption has been the launch of HMO. Human will always sacrifice infant formula business. We have the only imported brand in China to bring that product into the market, which is driving our end consumption state.

subtitles.zh: 如您所知，婴幼儿配方奶粉的前六个月非常关键。在第一阶段，我们的增长率达到68.8个百分点。上半年新增近50万新妈妈，这是基准。
subtitles.en: As you know, that you know for infant formula, the first six months are very critical. In stage one, we had a growth rate of 68.8 percentage point. We added almost 500,000 new mothers in the first half, which is the benchmark.

subtitles.zh: 我们持续专注于消费者教育和优质产品，这正在带来成果。即使在Swisse，我们也在优化产品组合。
subtitles.en: So our continuous focus on education superior products are delivering that. And even in Swiss, we are now downgrading. We are criminalizing the portfolio.

subtitles.zh: 我们逆势推出更高ASP的细分品类产品，以扩大市场。创新产品的平均ASP为2000元。
subtitles.en: We are going against the market defining trends of launching higher ASP niche category products to expand our address market. Our average ASP is 2000 RMP for the innovations.

subtitles.zh: 过去12个月，它们贡献了净销售额的10.6%。可以说，卓越的执行力、创新的方法和更好的营销推动了行业领先的业绩。
subtitles.en: And they contribute to 10.6% of NSR in the last 12 months. So that will say is the superior execution our innovative approach and better marketing is driving the best in class results.

briefs.speaker: Laetitia Garnier
briefs.speaker_context: CEO of H&H Group (Health and Happiness)
briefs.current_title: H&H集团CEO：不靠价格战，超高端婴配粉市占率创新高
current_title_lines: 超高端婴配粉市占率创新高

subtitles.zh: 目前婴幼儿配方奶粉的定价环境如何？竞争相当激烈，我们看到一些同行在中国市场因定价环境而利润率收缩。
subtitles.en: What is sort of the pricing environment now when it comes to infant formula? Because I think, you know, it's been quite competitive. And I think we've seen some of your peers in China, for example, have had to really, I've seen a contractio

subtitles.zh: 您是如何应对行业变化的？您眼中的定价环境是怎样的？
subtitles.en: I mean, how are you in some ways navigating around the sort of change in the industry? I mean, what is the pricing environment now and look like to you?

subtitles.zh: 问得好。如我所说，我们不是价格导向的品牌。我们的增长主要来自销量驱动。我们专注于超高端市场，不涉足中端或大众市场。
subtitles.en: It's a fair question, right? Like I said, we are not a price-led brand. Most of our growth is coming in the form of volume-led growth. We operate into the super premium segment. We are not into the mid-tier or the mastery, right?

subtitles.zh: 因为我们相信消费者教育是成功的关键。上半年，我们在超高端市场的份额达到历史新高20.6%，而去年同期为14.8%。
subtitles.en: Because we believe a consumer education is a key to success, right? So in this first half, our super premium market share reached an all-time high of 20.6% percentage point compared to 14.8% for the same period last year.

subtitles.zh: 所以我们没有降级，事实上，我们是超高端市场中增长最快的品牌之一。
subtitles.en: So we're not downgrading it. We are, in fact, one of the fastest-going brands into the super premium segment.

subtitles.zh: 即使在Swisse，我们的成人营养护理业务，也在提高高端产品组合的贡献，这帮助我们达到更高的毛利率门槛，并增加营销投入。
subtitles.en: And even in the Swiss, our adult nutrition care business, we are increasing percentage contribution from premiumization of our portfolio that is helping us to hit a higher cross margin threshold and invest more into marketing.

subtitles.zh: 因此，我们的差异化策略是通过消费者教育，而不是消费者降级。
subtitles.en: So we have taken an approach that our differentiation will come in the form of consumer education, then downgrading of consumers.

briefs.speaker: Laetitia Garnier
briefs.speaker_context: CEO of H&H Group (Health and Happiness)
briefs.current_title: H&H集团CEO：出生率下降但婴配粉市场仍具吸引力，宠物经济成新增长点
current_title_lines: 出生率下降但婴配粉市场仍具吸引力

subtitles.zh: 您对人口趋势有独特的见解。我不知道该怎么问这个问题。
subtitles.en: Right. You have a very unique perspective into demographic trends. I'm not sure how to phrase this question, right?

subtitles.zh: 人们是生更多孩子，还是我们看到趋势是晚育，甚至不生孩子而养宠物？
subtitles.en: So it's it's, you know, do people are people having more babies or we've seen the trend people having babies later in life, if not known to babies, but let's get a pet.

subtitles.zh: 您如何看待这两种趋势的对比？我读过一些文章，想知道我是否想多了。
subtitles.en: What trends are you seeing between one against the other? Am I over? I've read some articles around that and I wonder if I'm overthinking that.

subtitles.zh: 我想问的是，宠物经济是否比婴儿经济增长更快？
subtitles.en: Is the pet economy growing quicker than the infant economy is what I'm trying to get to here?

subtitles.zh: 当然。David，我认为没有好行业或坏行业，只有好的和坏的经营者。
subtitles.en: Sure. I mean, I think David, there is no good or bad industry, right? There are good and bad operators, right?

subtitles.zh: 这取决于你聚焦什么战略。是的，全球出生率并没有上升。
subtitles.en: So it depends upon what strategy that you want to focus, right? Yes, you're right. The global birth rate is not increasing, right?

Operating rule: 二极管法则
- A candidate is usable only if one emotion pole is unmistakable and emotion_tension is at least 8/10.
- The six permitted poles are: unexpected reversal, pleasant surprise, strong doubt, finally-someone-said-it candor, verified words-versus-actions contrast, and fact-based pride in a Chinese comparative advantage.
- Do not split the emotion across several mild ideas. Pick one pole and push it to the factual limit.
- A question mark is not emotion. "前景如何", "回报路径在哪", "能否实现", "面临哪些挑战", "回报存疑", and "释放什么信号" score at most 4 unless they contain a concrete contradiction or consequence.

Angle rules:
- surprise_reversal: state the familiar baseline, then expose the source claim that reverses it. Do not turn a baseline contrast into "改口" unless research.position_change.supported is true with at least two independent sources.
- outsider_candor: use only when a foreign institution/expert says something unusually direct. Keep the identity contrast in evidence_basis and viewer_reaction, then realize it in final copy by placing the specific surprising claim against its consequence. Never literally output 外资策略师、外资首席、罕见直言、外媒点破、终于有人说、只有外资敢说、大实话, or 西方机构承认.
- words_vs_actions: use only when research.words_vs_actions.supported is true and independent_source_count is at least 2. Show the two exact sides in question form. Never directly call anyone a liar.
- china_advantage: use only when research.china_advantage.supported is true. Put the concrete Chinese advantage or the foreign competitor's forced response in the foreground. The emotional direction must favor China.
- authority_breaks_consensus: the authority must be recognizable to a China audience, or be labeled by a meaningful role. Do not lead with an obscure romanized name.
- concrete_stakes: expose a specific number, forced choice, consequence, or who gains/loses. Generic importance is not a stake.

Writing rules:
- Style: factual clickbait for China finance audience
- Produce exactly four candidates per clip and use at least three different angle_id values when the evidence permits.
- Each candidate has exactly three short title lines. Think cover blocks, not a newspaper sentence.
- Ideal line lengths are 3-10, 4-12, and 5-14 Chinese characters. Full title is ideally 10-24 Chinese characters.
- The title must reveal enough familiar context to create a small information gap, then withhold the explanation supplied by the video.
- Prefer concrete verbs and consequences: 逼急、藏不住、说透、砍半. Use only when facts support them. "改口" requires research.position_change.supported with two independent sources; words-versus-actions phrases require research.words_vs_actions.supported with two independent sources.
- Do not mechanically copy examples or proper nouns from instructions. Derive every noun, number, actor, and comparison from this clip and its evidence card.
- angle_id, emotion_pole, and viewer_reaction are private editorial metadata. Never copy their wording into title or title_lines.
- Final cover structure should be [specific subject] / [unexpected fact or comparison] / [concrete unresolved consequence], not [speaker category] / [editorial label] / [topic].
- If a person or institution is genuinely recognizable, use its verified proper name. If it is not recognizable, omit the identity and lead with the subject and fact; do not replace it with generic labels such as 外资策略师 or 海外专家.
- For names and technical terms, use only the current clip's verified title_label. Never use official_zh/legal company names as cover copy, and never invent a Chinese transliteration when title_label is empty or English.

Tournament procedure, perform in this order:
1. Evidence veto: reject candidates that use a name, number, consensus, public action, comparison, or accusation not supported by that clip's transcript/research card.
2. China direction veto: for China-related clips, reject any candidate whose emotional target is China, Chinese people, Chinese companies, or China's future. Comparative pride is allowed only when supported.
3. Neutrality veto: reject flat summaries and generic questions. A question mark alone does not create tension.
4. Meta-copy veto: reject titles that expose the editor's reasoning with labels such as 外资策略师、外资首席、海外专家、西方策略师、罕见直言、外媒点破、终于有人说、只有外资敢说、大实话、 or 西方机构承认. The viewer should feel the effect from the facts, not be told how to feel.
5. Audience test: complete exactly one sentence: "看完标题，观众第一反应是____". If the answer is merely "我知道发生了什么", reject it.
6. Score survivors from 0-10. Final requires emotion_tension >= 8, novelty >= 7, specificity >= 7, curiosity_gap >= 7, factual_fidelity >= 9. For China clips, china_resonance >= 8.
7. Select the winner or combine only two candidates. If no candidate passes, write one new title, then score it honestly.
8. Before returning, verify every quality_check field. If any is false, rewrite once. Never return a known failure.

Editorial interpretation:
- 二极管 means one high-activation pole, not random anger: 意外, 惊喜, 强疑惑, 终于有人说, 有证据的言行反差, or 民族自豪.
- 新鲜感 requires a baseline plus a reversal. "外资谈中国" is ordinary; "外资在普遍悲观时罕见给出积极判断" is a usable reversal only if public_baseline supports it.
- 大实话 comes from who said what and why that identity makes the candor surprising. Do not paste "大实话" onto a routine forecast.
- 大实话、终于有人说、反差质疑 and 民族自豪 describe the intended viewer response internally. Do not print those labels or their editorial scaffolding in the title. Express them through the specific fact, comparison, and consequence.
- The desired effect of a possible falsehood angle is factual suspicion, not a verdict. Only when words_vs_actions is verified may you use a question such as "嘴上X，手里却Y？".
- "改口" means the same actor demonstrably held a different prior position. It requires research.position_change.supported and at least two independent sources. Never infer a change from search-result absence, lack of prior coverage, or a vague reputation.
- 民族自豪 comes from a concrete comparison: cost, technology, talent, supply chain, demand, speed, resilience, or a foreign competitor's forced adjustment. Do not use empty slogans.
- Familiar authority helps. Use a verified proper name only when the audience is likely to recognize it. Otherwise lead with the concrete subject; generic editorial identities such as 外资策略师、海外专家 or 西方策略师 are not final copy.
- Bloomberg/Bloomberg LP/彭博社 is normally the source, never the guest. Do not output 彭博有限合伙企业.
- Use only verified title_label values from this clip's entity/term card. Do not expand a familiar short name into a formal full name, and do not borrow an entity from another clip.

Title and display rules:
- Style: factual clickbait for China finance audience
- Use exactly three non-empty title lines, each a punchy cover block. Ideal lengths: 3-10, 4-12, 5-14 Chinese characters.
- Full title should be short and sharp, ideally 10-24 Chinese characters.
- Keep only one core conflict. Do not pack background, claim, caveat, and conclusion into one line.
- Highlights must be exact substrings of joined title_lines and emphasize the actor, number, reversal, China advantage, or tension.
- Do not use flat endings such as 回报路径在哪、回报存疑、前景如何、未来如何、有待观察、仍不明朗、面临挑战、带来机遇、释放信号、关键分叉在哪、有望扩大. Turn the caveat into a concrete unresolved action or contradiction.
- Every line must be a complete Chinese phrase. Do not leave a transitive tension verb such as 逼急、逼到、迫使 or 倒逼 without its subject or object.
- Do not use source badges, emojis, markdown, quotation marks, hashtags, or numbering.
- Title fields must not contain 资产管理、投资、股票、基金、理财、保险、投顾、荐股、买入、卖出.
- Never use 经济危机、金融危机、债务危机、危机、崩盘、崩溃、完了、没救、惨了.
- Do not mention sensitive geopolitical or military topics.

KC comment rules:
- comment starts with KC评论： and adds context, consequence, or the next fact to watch in 16-34 Chinese characters. Do not repeat the title.
- subtitle_comments contains one item for every input subtitle index, grounded in that exact subtitle rather than a generic clip slogan.
- Each subtitle comment starts with KC评论： and is ideally 10-24 Chinese characters after the prefix, with a complete ending.
- Adjacent subtitle comments must vary between evidence, implication, tension, consequence, and context.
- All highlight strings must be exact substrings of their corresponding title/comment.

current_title_lines: 税政澄清影响有限，多元化布局稳定业务
内地客户需求未见明显变化

subtitles.zh: 有消息提到内地，你可能知道，关于股息税征收的事。
subtitles.en: I mean, there's been news speaking of mainland China, and you probably know about this, a tax dividend tax collection.

subtitles.zh: 你注意到内地客户需求的变化或势头有什么改变吗？
subtitles.en: Have you noticed any change in the delta and the momentum on demand for mainland clients here?

subtitles.zh: 这个话题我们讨论很多，并不意外。两地监管机构都在澄清情况，同业也有交流。
subtitles.en: I think we had quite a bit about this topic, so less than a surprise here. And I think you have, from the regulators, from both side of the board, is clarifying the situation and our friends from different companies and share.

subtitles.zh: 对我们来说类似。这并非新规，内地居民本就需申报并缴纳境外收益税。
subtitles.en: For us, it's similar. So I think it's not new in a sense that this is existing regulation, not mainland Chinese residents, need to declare and pay tax on offshore investment income.

subtitles.zh: 这只是一次澄清，监管机构也提醒不应过度解读。
subtitles.en: So this is just for a sort of clarification, and as the regulators say, we should not be over speculative or overinterpreted this.

subtitles.zh: 因此我们持类似看法。过去两个月，内地客户的保障产品销售有变化吗？
subtitles.en: So in that sense, we are looking at it in a similar way. Have you seen any changes in insurance sales from the mainland in the last two months then?

subtitles.zh: 没有，我们没有看到变化。这也是多元化带来的好处。
subtitles.en: No, we have not. We have not that. We have not. But that's also a benefit, because we are very diversified.

subtitles.zh: 在香港，我们与约290家经纪和独立理财顾问合作，还有14家银行伙伴，以及高素质的代理人队伍。这种多元化带来业务稳定性。
subtitles.en: In Hong Kong, for example, we partner with something like 290 Prokers and IFA. We have 14 banks, partners, and we have a very strong and high quality agency force. That diversification gives us the stability across the business.

subtitles.zh: 在10个市场也是如此，多元化是关键。
subtitles.en: And the same thing applies across the region with 10 markets. The diversified diversification is a key for us.

subtitles.zh: 高净值群体的独特需求是什么？他们需要哪些其他群体没有的服务？

subtitles.zh: 他们的资金规模如何？这种模式会复制到其他市场吗？

subtitles.zh: 高净值业务目前占总业务的9%，规模不小，且持续增长。
subtitles.en: So for handnet worth, if you look at in total business now, it's about 9% of business, so it's not small. Of total. So it's quite important and growing.

subtitles.zh: 这类客户有特定需求，如财务规划和传承保障，与大众富裕市场截然不同。
subtitles.en: And what important for this segment of clients is they have a very specific need that the financial planning, the legacy protection, so it's very different than the mass market, the mass affluent market.

subtitles.zh: 因此产品和服务必须高度定制化，提供白手套服务。我们需要构建全球网络，实现“跟随太阳”模式。

briefs.current_title: Aberdeen亚太权益资产主管：中国互联网AI投入短期承压，长期结构性机会显现
current_title_lines: 中国互联网AI投入短期承压

subtitles.zh: 目前两者兼有，但考虑到中国市场的估值水平，我们认为这也是一个结构性机会。
subtitles.en: It's both at this point, but we do think that, you know, given where the Chinese valuation is, it is a structural opportunity as well.

subtitles.zh: 比如中国互联网企业，尤其是AI相关标的，正经历一段波动较大的时期。
subtitles.en: I mean, I think the China Internet names, for example, the AI plays are going through a pretty volatile time.

subtitles.zh: 腾讯和阿里巴巴在财报季之后也出现了不少抛售。
subtitles.en: We have seen quite a fair bit of self-off post-earning seasons from Tencent and Alibaba as well.

subtitles.zh: 这些公司正利用自由现金流加速AI资本开支，为未来增长布局。
subtitles.en: As what you are seeing with these companies is that they are using the free cash flow to really accelerate their investment in AI KPEX for future growth.

subtitles.zh: 有趣的是，这些资本开支的回报周期在改善，因为他们开始将云业务收入变现，利润率也在提升。
subtitles.en: And I think what's interesting behind that is that we are seeing better payback periods as well from the KPEX they are making as they are able to start monetizing their cloud revenue and earning higher margins.

subtitles.zh: 但目前投资者似乎不太认可这种用自由现金流投入、短期影响盈利的做法。
subtitles.en: But I think at this point what we are seeing is that investors don't really like the story that you are using your free cash flow to actually seeing that short-term impact on their earnings.

subtitles.zh: 这反而为我们提供了有趣的入场机会，我认为当前时点这是一个相当逆向的观点。
subtitles.en: And that, I think, represents an interesting opportunity for us, and I do think that is a fair bit of a contrarian call for us at this point in time as well.

- A candidate is usable only if one emotion pole is unmistakable and emotion_tension is at least 8/10.
- The six permitted poles are: unexpected reversal, pleasant surprise, strong doubt, finally-someone-said-it candor, verified words-versus-actions contrast, and fact-based pride in a Chinese comparative advantage.

- words_vs_actions: use only when research.words_vs_actions.supported is true and independent_source_count is at least 2. Show the two exact sides in question form. Never directly call anyone a liar.
- china_advantage: use only when research.china_advantage.supported is true. Put the concrete Chinese advantage or the foreign competitor's forced response in the foreground. The emotional direction must favor China.
- authority_breaks_consensus: the authority must be recognizable to a China audience, or be labeled by a meaningful role. Do not lead with an obscure romanized name.
- concrete_stakes: expose a specific number, forced choice, consequence, or who gains/loses. Generic importance is not a stake.

Writing rules:
- Style: factual clickbait for China finance audience
- Produce exactly four candidates per clip and use at least three different angle_id values when the evidence permits.
- Each candidate has exactly three short title lines. Think cover blocks, not a newspaper sentence.
- Ideal line lengths are 3-10, 4-12, and 5-14 Chinese characters. Full title is ideally 10-24 Chinese characters.
- The title must reveal enough familiar context to create a small information gap, then withhold the explanation supplied by the video.
- Prefer concrete verbs and consequences: 逼急、藏不住、说透、砍半. Use only when facts support them. "改口" requires research.position_change.supported with two independent sources; words-versus-actions phrases require research.words_vs_actions.supported with two independent sources.

- For China-related clips, never attack China or imply national decline. Favor confidence, competence, policy room, industrial strength, cost advantage, talent, resilience, and competitors being forced to respond.

Tournament procedure, perform in this order:
1. Evidence veto: reject candidates that use a name, number, consensus, public action, comparison, or accusation not supported by that clip's transcript/research card.
2. China direction veto: for China-related clips, reject any candidate whose emotional target is China, Chinese people, Chinese companies, or China's future. Comparative pride is allowed only when supported.
3. Neutrality veto: reject flat summaries and generic questions. A question mark alone does not create tension.
4. Meta-copy veto: reject titles that expose the editor's reasoning with labels such as 外资策略师、外资首席、海外专家、西方策略师、罕见直言、外媒点破、终于有人说、只有外资敢说、大实话、 or 西方机构承认. The viewer should feel the effect from the facts, not be told how to feel.
5. Audience test: complete exactly one sentence: "看完标题，观众第一反应是____". If the answer is merely "我知道发生了什么", reject it.
6. Score survivors from 0-10. Final requires emotion_tension >= 8, novelty >= 7, specificity >= 7, curiosity_gap >= 7, factual_fidelity >= 9. For China clips, china_resonance >= 8.
7. Select the winner or combine only two candidates. If no candidate passes, write one new title, then score it honestly.

- 二极管 means one high-activation pole, not random anger: 意外, 惊喜, 强疑惑, 终于有人说, 有证据的言行反差, or 民族自豪.

- "改口" means the same actor demonstrably held a different prior position. It requires research.position_change.supported and at least two independent sources. Never infer a change from search-result absence, lack of prior coverage, or a vague reputation.

Tournament procedure, perform in this order:
1. Evidence veto: reject candidates that use a name, number, consensus, public action, comparison, or accusation not supported by that clip's transcript/research card.
2. China direction veto: for China-related clips, reject any candidate whose emotional target is China, Chinese people, Chinese companies, or China's future. Comparative pride is allowed only when supported.
3. Neutrality veto: reject flat summaries and generic questions. A question mark alone does not create tension.
4. Meta-copy veto: reject titles that expose the editor's reasoning with labels such as 外资策略师、外资首席、海外专家、西方策略师、罕见直言、外媒点破、终于有人说、只有外资敢说、大实话、 or 西方机构承认. The viewer should feel the effect from the facts, not be told how to feel.
5. Audience test: complete exactly one sentence: "看完标题，观众第一反应是____". If the answer is merely "我知道发生了什么", reject it.
6. Score survivors from 0-10. Final requires emotion_tension >= 8, novelty >= 7, specificity >= 7, curiosity_gap >= 7, factual_fidelity >= 9. For China clips, china_resonance >= 8.
7. Select the winner or combine only two candidates. If no candidate passes, write one new title, then score it honestly.
8. Before returning, verify every quality_check field. If any is false, rewrite once. Never return a known failure.

Editorial interpretation:
- 二极管 means one high-activation pole, not random anger: 意外, 惊喜, 强疑惑, 终于有人说, 有证据的言行反差, or 民族自豪.
- 新鲜感 requires a baseline plus a reversal. "外资谈中国" is ordinary; "外资在普遍悲观时罕见给出积极判断" is a usable reversal only if public_baseline supports it.
- 大实话 comes from who said what and why that identity makes the candor surprising. Do not paste "大实话" onto a routine forecast.
- 大实话、终于有人说、反差质疑 and 民族自豪 describe the intended viewer response internally. Do not print those labels or their editorial scaffolding in the title. Express them through the specific fact, comparison, and consequence.
- The desired effect of a possible falsehood angle is factual suspicion, not a verdict. Only when words_vs_actions is verified may you use a question such as "嘴上X，手里却Y？".
- "改口" means the same actor demonstrably held a different prior position. It requires research.position_change.supported and at least two independent sources. Never infer a change from search-result absence, lack of prior coverage, or a vague reputation.
- 民族自豪 comes from a concrete comparison: cost, technology, talent, supply chain, demand, speed, resilience, or a foreign competitor's forced adjustment. Do not use empty slogans.
- Familiar authority helps. Use a verified proper name only when the audience is likely to recognize it. Otherwise lead with the concrete subject; generic editorial identities such as 外资策略师、海外专家 or 西方策略师 are not final copy.
- Bloomberg/Bloomberg LP/彭博社 is normally the source, never the guest. Do not output 彭博有限合伙企业.
- Use only verified title_label values from this clip's entity/term card. Do not expand a familiar short name into a formal full name, and do not borrow an entity from another clip.

- Style: factual clickbait for China finance audience
- Use exactly three non-empty title lines, each a punchy cover block. Ideal lengths: 3-10, 4-12, 5-14 Chinese characters.
- Full title should be short and sharp, ideally 10-24 Chinese characters.
- Keep only one core conflict. Do not pack background, claim, caveat, and conclusion into one line.

briefs.current_title: Aberdeen亚太权益资产主管：AI交易中如何布局中国互联网与高股息？
current_title_lines: 互联网与高股息双管齐下

subtitles.zh: 从更广的视角看，我们一直在做一定对冲。比如在AI交易中，我们增持了中国互联网公司，尽管市场抛售，但我们对其长期轨迹和公司战略仍持乐观态度。
subtitles.en: Yes, so from a broader perspective, we have been hedging ourselves a bit in a sense that as we are adding to the AI trade, whether you look at us adding more to the China Internet names as they get so off by the market, but we are still pos

subtitles.zh: 我们也在增持金融类公司，它们的盈利相对稳健，一些消费类公司的股息率也较高。
subtitles.en: We are also adding more to the likes of financials, for example, where earnings have also been relatively resilient, and some of the consumer stocks also have pretty high dividend use.

subtitles.zh: 这是一种均衡策略，既配置中国高股息标的，也配置中国互联网等成长型标的。
subtitles.en: So a bit of a well-strategy there, where we are invested in both the high dividend use stocks in China, but also the growth stocks like China Internet.

subtitles.zh: 在AI交易中，我们也在做所谓的中国AI本土化布局，投资于资本开支相关的设备领域。
subtitles.en: And within this, when you talk about the AI trade, we have also been doing quite a fair bit of what you call China AI localization play, investing in the KPEX equipments.

subtitles.zh: 我们看到企业确实在加大资本开支，因此我们也希望参与中国这一供应链的故事。
subtitles.en: As we know that when we look at and connect the dots, companies are really uping their game with regard to KPEX, and therefore we would want to be part of that supply chain story in China as well.

subtitles.en: Yes, so I think, and again, back to the earning season as we are in the midst of it, but as we go through the earnings of our Indian companies, I think what's standing out quite clear this time, which we have not seen for many quarters actu

subtitles.en: So this time, I think the key change is that we are seeing a change in fundamentals and earnings is really starting to come back.

subtitles.en: You might ask us what are the stocks that we like. Starting with the financials, it is a good place to play.

You are a Chinese viral-title angle architect. Return strict JSON only. Do not write a safe summary. Generate competing, fact-grounded emotional angles for each clip. Each candidate must make a viewer feel one strong reaction instead of mild interest. Use the research guide as a hard boundary: unsupported surprise, dishonesty, holdings, public actions, and national comparisons are forbidden. Wording guard for all Chinese output:
- Do not use hard crisis/doom financial wording such as 经济危机、金融危机、债务危机、流动性危机、危机、崩盘、崩溃、完了、没救、惨了、萧条、衰退.

- For China-related clips, do not frame China, Chinese companies, Chinese assets, Chinese consumers, or Chinese policy as hopeless, collapsing, being mocked, or fundamentally bad.
- If the source is negative about China-related macro/markets, keep the fact but soften the Chinese wording: talk about pressure, policy response, demand repair, liquidity change, confidence repair, valuation reset, or structural adjustment.
- Never directly use 房价/房價/住房价格/住宅价格/房屋价格/楼市价格 in Chinese output. Preserve the source direction, number, and unit, but paraphrase by context: use 地产市场上行/调整/趋稳/修复 for direction, 居住成本/住房可负担性/置业负担 for affordability, 地产估值 for valuation, and 住宅成交水平 for absolute levels. Do not evade this rule with another blunt housing-price synonym.

Operating rule: 二极管法则
- A candidate is usable only if one emotion pole is unmistakable and emotion_tension is at least 8/10.
- The six permitted poles are: unexpected reversal, pleasant surprise, strong doubt, finally-someone-said-it candor, verified words-versus-actions contrast, and fact-based pride in a Chinese comparative advantage.
- Do not split the emotion across several mild ideas. Pick one pole and push it to the factual limit.
- A question mark is not emotion. "前景如何", "回报路径在哪", "能否实现", "面临哪些挑战", "回报存疑", and "释放什么信号" score at most 4 unless they contain a concrete contradiction or consequence.

Angle rules:
- surprise_reversal: state the familiar baseline, then expose the source claim that reverses it. Do not turn a baseline contrast into "改口" unless research.position_change.supported is true with at least two independent sources.
- outsider_candor: use only when a foreign institution/expert says something unusually direct. Keep the identity contrast in evidence_basis and viewer_reaction, then realize it in final copy by placing the specific surprising claim against its consequence. Never literally output 外资策略师、外资首席、罕见直言、外媒点破、终于有人说、只有外资敢说、大实话, or 西方机构承认.
- words_vs_actions: use only when research.words_vs_actions.supported is true and independent_source_count is at least 2. Show the two exact sides in question form. Never directly call anyone a liar.
- china_advantage: use only when research.china_advantage.supported is true. Put the concrete Chinese advantage or the foreign competitor's forced response in the foreground. The emotional direction must favor China.
- authority_breaks_consensus: the authority must be recognizable to a China audience, or be labeled by a meaningful role. Do not lead with an obscure romanized name.
- concrete_stakes: expose a specific number, forced choice, consequence, or who gains/loses. Generic importance is not a stake.

Writing rules:
- Style: factual clickbait for China finance audience
- Produce exactly four candidates per clip and use at least three different angle_id values when the evidence permits.
- Each candidate has exactly three short title lines. Think cover blocks, not a newspaper sentence.
- Ideal line lengths are 3-10, 4-12, and 5-14 Chinese characters. Full title is ideally 10-24 Chinese characters.
- The title must reveal enough familiar context to create a small information gap, then withhold the explanation supplied by the video.
- Prefer concrete verbs and consequences: 逼急、藏不住、说透、砍半. Use only when facts support them. "改口" requires research.position_change.supported with two independent sources; words-versus-actions phrases require research.words_vs_actions.supported with two independent sources.
- Do not mechanically copy examples or proper nouns from instructions. Derive every noun, number, actor, and comparison from this clip and its evidence card.
- angle_id, emotion_pole, and viewer_reaction are private editorial metadata. Never copy their wording into title or title_lines.
- Final cover structure should be [specific subject] / [unexpected fact or comparison] / [concrete unresolved consequence], not [speaker category] / [editorial label] / [topic].
- If a person or institution is genuinely recognizable, use its verified proper name. If it is not recognizable, omit the identity and lead with the subject and fact; do not replace it with generic labels such as 外资策略师 or 海外专家.
- For names and technical terms, use only the current clip's verified title_label. Never use official_zh/legal company names as cover copy, and never invent a Chinese transliteration when title_label is empty or English.
- Bloomberg/Bloomberg LP/彭博社 is a source label, not the expert or actor. Company legal suffixes do not belong in a title.
- For China-related clips, never attack China or imply national decline. Favor confidence, competence, policy room, industrial strength, cost advantage, talent, resilience, and competitors being forced to respond.
- If the clip is negative about China and no constructive factual angle exists, use a neutral mechanism question instead of nationalist or doom framing.
- Forbidden title words: 资产管理、投资、股票、基金、理财、保险、投顾、荐股、买入、卖出.
- Forbidden hard-negative wording: 经济危机、金融危机、债务危机、危机、崩盘、崩溃、完了、没救、惨了.
- Do not use sensitive geopolitical or military subjects, emojis, markdown, quotation marks, hashtags, or numbered prefixes.
- If evidence cannot support four dramatic factual claims, vary the framing and use strong questions; never fabricate the missing drama.

Tournament procedure, perform in this order:
1. Evidence veto: reject candidates that use a name, number, consensus, public action, comparison, or accusation not supported by that clip's transcript/research card.
2. China direction veto: for China-related clips, reject any candidate whose emotional target is China, Chinese people, Chinese companies, or China's future. Comparative pride is allowed only when supported.
3. Neutrality veto: reject flat summaries and generic questions. A question mark alone does not create tension.
4. Meta-copy veto: reject titles that expose the editor's reasoning with labels such as 外资策略师、外资首席、海外专家、西方策略师、罕见直言、外媒点破、终于有人说、只有外资敢说、大实话、 or 西方机构承认. The viewer should feel the effect from the facts, not be told how to feel.
5. Audience test: complete exactly one sentence: "看完标题，观众第一反应是____". If the answer is merely "我知道发生了什么", reject it.
6. Score survivors from 0-10. Final requires emotion_tension >= 8, novelty >= 7, specificity >= 7, curiosity_gap >= 7, factual_fidelity >= 9. For China clips, china_resonance >= 8.
7. Select the winner or combine only two candidates. If no candidate passes, write one new title, then score it honestly.
8. Before returning, verify every quality_check field. If any is false, rewrite once. Never return a known failure.

Editorial interpretation:
- 二极管 means one high-activation pole, not random anger: 意外, 惊喜, 强疑惑, 终于有人说, 有证据的言行反差, or 民族自豪.

- 大实话 comes from who said what and why that identity makes the candor surprising. Do not paste "大实话" onto a routine forecast.
- 大实话、终于有人说、反差质疑 and 民族自豪 describe the intended viewer response internally. Do not print those labels or their editorial scaffolding in the title. Express them through the specific fact, comparison, and consequence.
- The desired effect of a possible falsehood angle is factual suspicion, not a verdict. Only when words_vs_actions is verified may you use a question such as "嘴上X，手里却Y？".
- "改口" means the same actor demonstrably held a different prior position. It requires research.position_change.supported and at least two independent sources. Never infer a change from search-result absence, lack of prior coverage, or a vague reputation.
- 民族自豪 comes from a concrete comparison: cost, technology, talent, supply chain, demand, speed, resilience, or a foreign competitor's forced adjustment. Do not use empty slogans.

Tournament procedure, perform in this order:
1. Evidence veto: reject candidates that use a name, number, consensus, public action, comparison, or accusation not supported by that clip's transcript/research card.
2. China direction veto: for China-related clips, reject any candidate whose emotional target is China, Chinese people, Chinese companies, or China's future. Comparative pride is allowed only when supported.
3. Neutrality veto: reject flat summaries and generic questions. A question mark alone does not create tension.
4. Meta-copy veto: reject titles that expose the editor's reasoning with labels such as 外资策略师、外资首席、海外专家、西方策略师、罕见直言、外媒点破、终于有人说、只有外资敢说、大实话、 or 西方机构承认. The viewer should feel the effect from the facts, not be told how to feel.
5. Audience test: complete exactly one sentence: "看完标题，观众第一反应是____". If the answer is merely "我知道发生了什么", reject it.
6. Score survivors from 0-10. Final requires emotion_tension >= 8, novelty >= 7, specificity >= 7, curiosity_gap >= 7, factual_fidelity >= 9. For China clips, china_resonance >= 8.
7. Select the winner or combine only two candidates. If no candidate passes, write one new title, then score it honestly.
8. Before returning, verify every quality_check field. If any is false, rewrite once. Never return a known failure.

Editorial interpretation:
- 二极管 means one high-activation pole, not random anger: 意外, 惊喜, 强疑惑, 终于有人说, 有证据的言行反差, or 民族自豪.
- 新鲜感 requires a baseline plus a reversal. "外资谈中国" is ordinary; "外资在普遍悲观时罕见给出积极判断" is a usable reversal only if public_baseline supports it.
- 大实话 comes from who said what and why that identity makes the candor surprising. Do not paste "大实话" onto a routine forecast.
- 大实话、终于有人说、反差质疑 and 民族自豪 describe the intended viewer response internally. Do not print those labels or their editorial scaffolding in the title. Express them through the specific fact, comparison, and consequence.
- The desired effect of a possible falsehood angle is factual suspicion, not a verdict. Only when words_vs_actions is verified may you use a question such as "嘴上X，手里却Y？".
- "改口" means the same actor demonstrably held a different prior position. It requires research.position_change.supported and at least two independent sources. Never infer a change from search-result absence, lack of prior coverage, or a vague reputation.
- 民族自豪 comes from a concrete comparison: cost, technology, talent, supply chain, demand, speed, resilience, or a foreign competitor's forced adjustment. Do not use empty slogans.
- Familiar authority helps. Use a verified proper name only when the audience is likely to recognize it. Otherwise lead with the concrete subject; generic editorial identities such as 外资策略师、海外专家 or 西方策略师 are not final copy.
- Bloomberg/Bloomberg LP/彭博社 is normally the source, never the guest. Do not output 彭博有限合伙企业.
- Use only verified title_label values from this clip's entity/term card. Do not expand a familiar short name into a formal full name, and do not borrow an entity from another clip.

subtitles.en: Our biggest disruption has been the launch of HMO. Human will always sacrifice infant formula business. We have the only imported brand in China to bring that product into the market, which is driving our end consumption state.

subtitles.zh: 目前婴幼儿配方奶粉的定价环境如何？竞争相当激烈，我们看到一些同行在中国市场因定价环境而利润率收缩。
subtitles.en: What is sort of the pricing environment now when it comes to infant formula? Because I think, you know, it's been quite competitive. And I think we've seen some of your peers in China, for example, have had to really, I've seen a contractio

subtitles.zh: 您是如何应对行业变化的？您眼中的定价环境是怎样的？
subtitles.en: I mean, how are you in some ways navigating around the sort of change in the industry? I mean, what is the pricing environment now and look like to you?

subtitles.zh: 问得好。如我所说，我们不是价格导向的品牌。我们的增长主要来自销量驱动。我们专注于超高端市场，不涉足中端或大众市场。
subtitles.en: It's a fair question, right? Like I said, we are not a price-led brand. Most of our growth is coming in the form of volume-led growth. We operate into the super premium segment. We are not into the mid-tier or the mastery, right?

subtitles.zh: 因为我们相信消费者教育是成功的关键。上半年，我们在超高端市场的份额达到历史新高20.6%，而去年同期为14.8%。
subtitles.en: Because we believe a consumer education is a key to success, right? So in this first half, our super premium market share reached an all-time high of 20.6% percentage point compared to 14.8% for the same period last year.

subtitles.zh: 所以我们没有降级，事实上，我们是超高端市场中增长最快的品牌之一。
subtitles.en: So we're not downgrading it. We are, in fact, one of the fastest-going brands into the super premium segment.

subtitles.zh: 即使在Swisse，我们的成人营养护理业务，也在提高高端产品组合的贡献，这帮助我们达到更高的毛利率门槛，并增加营销投入。
subtitles.en: And even in the Swiss, our adult nutrition care business, we are increasing percentage contribution from premiumization of our portfolio that is helping us to hit a higher cross margin threshold and invest more into marketing.

subtitles.zh: 因此，我们的差异化策略是通过消费者教育，而不是消费者降级。
subtitles.en: So we have taken an approach that our differentiation will come in the form of consumer education, then downgrading of consumers.

subtitles.zh: 我想问的是，宠物经济是否比婴儿经济增长更快？
subtitles.en: Is the pet economy growing quicker than the infant economy is what I'm trying to get to here?

subtitles.zh: 当然。David，我认为没有好行业或坏行业，只有好的和坏的经营者。
subtitles.en: Sure. I mean, I think David, there is no good or bad industry, right? There are good and bad operators, right?

subtitles.zh: 这取决于你聚焦什么战略。是的，全球出生率并没有上升。
subtitles.en: So it depends upon what strategy that you want to focus, right? Yes, you're right. The global birth rate is not increasing, right?

subtitles.zh: 这不是单一市场现象，而是全球现象。生育率在下降。
subtitles.en: And that's not in one market. This is across the phenomenon, right? The fertility rates are down, right?

subtitles.zh: 但这并不意味着婴幼儿配方奶粉市场没有吸引力。它仍然是如何更贴近家庭的问题。
subtitles.en: But that doesn't mean that the infant formula market is not very attractive. It still remains how you get closer to the family, right?

subtitles.zh: 你建立信任。Biostime在中国做得很好，我们在法国市场也做了很多工作。
subtitles.en: You build your trust into that, right? And biostat has done a relatively very good job in China and also the work that we've done into the French market, right?

subtitles.zh: Biostime的大部分生产都在法国。但你说得对，宠物收养率在上升。
subtitles.en: With majority of our production for biostat happens. But your right pet adoption rate is increasing, right?

subtitles.zh: 自疫情以来，这一趋势持续，没有加速，而是趋于稳定。

briefs.speaker: Huynh Thanh Phong
briefs.speaker_context: CEO of FWD Group
briefs.current_title: 富卫集团CEO：税政澄清影响有限，多元化布局稳定业务
current_title_lines: 税政澄清影响有限，多元化布局稳定业务
内地客户需求未见明显变化

subtitles.zh: 有消息提到内地，你可能知道，关于股息税征收的事。
subtitles.en: I mean, there's been news speaking of mainland China, and you probably know about this, a tax dividend tax collection.

subtitles.zh: 你注意到内地客户需求的变化或势头有什么改变吗？
subtitles.en: Have you noticed any change in the delta and the momentum on demand for mainland clients here?

subtitles.zh: 这个话题我们讨论很多，并不意外。两地监管机构都在澄清情况，同业也有交流。
subtitles.en: I think we had quite a bit about this topic, so less than a surprise here. And I think you have, from the regulators, from both side of the board, is clarifying the situation and our friends from different companies and share.

subtitles.zh: 对我们来说类似。这并非新规，内地居民本就需申报并缴纳境外收益税。
subtitles.en: For us, it's similar. So I think it's not new in a sense that this is existing regulation, not mainland Chinese residents, need to declare and pay tax on offshore investment income.

subtitles.zh: 这只是一次澄清，监管机构也提醒不应过度解读。
subtitles.en: So this is just for a sort of clarification, and as the regulators say, we should not be over speculative or overinterpreted this.

subtitles.zh: 因此我们持类似看法。过去两个月，内地客户的保障产品销售有变化吗？
subtitles.en: So in that sense, we are looking at it in a similar way. Have you seen any changes in insurance sales from the mainland in the last two months then?

subtitles.zh: 没有，我们没有看到变化。这也是多元化带来的好处。
subtitles.en: No, we have not. We have not that. We have not. But that's also a benefit, because we are very diversified.

subtitles.zh: 在香港，我们与约290家经纪和独立理财顾问合作，还有14家银行伙伴，以及高素质的代理人队伍。这种多元化带来业务稳定性。
subtitles.en: In Hong Kong, for example, we partner with something like 290 Prokers and IFA. We have 14 banks, partners, and we have a very strong and high quality agency force. That diversification gives us the stability across the business.

subtitles.zh: 在10个市场也是如此，多元化是关键。
subtitles.en: And the same thing applies across the region with 10 markets. The diversified diversification is a key for us.

briefs.speaker: Huynh Thanh Phong
briefs.speaker_context: CEO of FWD Group
briefs.current_title: 富卫集团CEO：新兴市场增长强劲，菲律宾市场排名第一
current_title_lines: 新兴市场增长强劲，菲律宾市场排名第一
数字化渠道助力马来西亚市场

subtitles.zh: 这是我们非常看好的市场群，越南和印尼都令人鼓舞。
subtitles.en: That's one cluster that we are very excited about, being Vietnamese double in encouraging.

subtitles.zh: 周一刚与越南财长交流市场情况，我们非常兴奋。
subtitles.en: I think yesterday, on Monday, it was with the virus, with the finance in Vietnam, talking about the market. So we are quite excited.

subtitles.zh: 上半年该市场群增长23%。新加坡等地的独立理财顾问渠道增长强劲，我们已占据有利位置。
subtitles.en: If you look at the first half, we grew by 23% across this cluster. And the price was, if you look at this place like Singapore, it's very strong growth in the IFA program markets, and we were positioned in that market.

subtitles.zh: 在菲律宾，我们与银行伙伴Security Bank紧密合作，今年聚焦财富管理领域，增长强劲，现已位居菲律宾市场第一。
subtitles.en: In Philippines, we were very closely with our bank partner, security bank, and we really focused on the wealth segment this year, and we see strong growth, and now we're number one in the Philippines.

subtitles.zh: 马来西亚同样令人惊喜，我们在数字商务方面非常强劲。
subtitles.en: Malaysia, surprisingly, we, again, are very encouraging. We are now very strong in digital commerce, for example.

subtitles.zh: 不同市场采取不同策略，使我们在数字市场占据强势地位。你提到富卫私人业务，很有意思。
subtitles.en: So different approach in different markets give us a very strong position in the digital market. You mentioned about FWD private, which is quite interesting, right?

current_title_lines: 高净值业务成新引擎，全球网络布局加速
与私行合作，打造全球服务能力

subtitles.zh: 它有何独特之处？作为保险公司，你如何与私人银行竞争？
subtitles.en: Just tell us what's unique about it. How do you, as an assure like yourself, how do you compete to be like, you know, with the other private banks out there?

subtitles.zh: 我们与私人银行紧密合作，并聚焦国际市场。过去十年我们与私行建立了关系，在此基础上发展。
subtitles.en: I think we partner very closely with the private banks and the international focus for this market space. And on the private banks, we have relationship with private banks for the past decade, so we build on that strength.

subtitles.zh: 在国际聚焦方面，去年我们翻倍增长，这些是高净值业务的关键渠道。
subtitles.en: But international focus, if you look at the last year, we actually double up, and these are the key channels for the handnet worth.

subtitles.zh: 高净值客户需要涵盖储蓄和保障两方面的产品组合，香港在储蓄方面很强。
subtitles.en: And when it comes to handnet worth, you need to have a product suite that covers both the saving space, which Hong Kong is very good at, and but also in protection space.

subtitles.zh: 新加坡在保障方面做得不错，香港需要追赶。我们将在香港、新加坡、百慕大等地布局，未来拓展更多地区。
subtitles.en: This is something that Singapore might be doing well, but in Hong Kong, we should be catching up, and to have that range of product position and the service, and the presence in Hong Kong and Singapore in Bermuda, and in the future in other

subtitles.zh: 高净值群体的独特需求是什么？他们需要哪些其他群体没有的服务？
subtitles.en: What's unique about that specific segment of handnet worth? In other words, what does that group need that largely exists only with that group that you don't get across the different parts of your franchise?

subtitles.zh: 他们的资金规模如何？这种模式会复制到其他市场吗？
subtitles.en: In other words, how much money does that have? And is that something that you might look to replicate elsewhere?

subtitles.zh: 高净值业务目前占总业务的9%，规模不小，且持续增长。
subtitles.en: So for handnet worth, if you look at in total business now, it's about 9% of business, so it's not small. Of total. So it's quite important and growing.

subtitles.zh: 这类客户有特定需求，如财务规划和传承保障，与大众富裕市场截然不同。
subtitles.en: And what important for this segment of clients is they have a very specific need that the financial planning, the legacy protection, so it's very different than the mass market, the mass affluent market.

subtitles.zh: 因此产品和服务必须高度定制化，提供白手套服务。我们需要构建全球网络，实现“跟随太阳”模式。
subtitles.en: So your product set and your service, the white glove service that you always have to be very different. And the fact that we need to build a global network in order to follow the sun kind of model.

subtitles.zh: 这个细分市场非常重要。最近我们聘请了资深人士来打造全球高净值业务。
subtitles.en: So we're always on for this kind segment, it's really important. So recently we just hired very senior people to come in and build what we call the global handnet worth business for us.

briefs.speaker_context: Head of Equities, Asia Pacific at Aberdeen Investments
briefs.current_title: Aberdeen亚太权益资产主管：中国互联网AI投入短期承压，长期结构性机会显现
current_title_lines: 中国互联网AI投入短期承压

subtitles.zh: 目前两者兼有，但考虑到中国市场的估值水平，我们认为这也是一个结构性机会。
subtitles.en: It's both at this point, but we do think that, you know, given where the Chinese valuation is, it is a structural opportunity as well.

subtitles.zh: 比如中国互联网企业，尤其是AI相关标的，正经历一段波动较大的时期。
subtitles.en: I mean, I think the China Internet names, for example, the AI plays are going through a pretty volatile time.

subtitles.zh: 腾讯和阿里巴巴在财报季之后也出现了不少抛售。
subtitles.en: We have seen quite a fair bit of self-off post-earning seasons from Tencent and Alibaba as well.

subtitles.zh: 这些公司正利用自由现金流加速AI资本开支，为未来增长布局。
subtitles.en: As what you are seeing with these companies is that they are using the free cash flow to really accelerate their investment in AI KPEX for future growth.

subtitles.zh: 有趣的是，这些资本开支的回报周期在改善，因为他们开始将云业务收入变现，利润率也在提升。
subtitles.en: And I think what's interesting behind that is that we are seeing better payback periods as well from the KPEX they are making as they are able to start monetizing their cloud revenue and earning higher margins.

subtitles.zh: 但目前投资者似乎不太认可这种用自由现金流投入、短期影响盈利的做法。
subtitles.en: But I think at this point what we are seeing is that investors don't really like the story that you are using your free cash flow to actually seeing that short-term impact on their earnings.

subtitles.zh: 这反而为我们提供了有趣的入场机会，我认为当前时点这是一个相当逆向的观点。
subtitles.en: And that, I think, represents an interesting opportunity for us, and I do think that is a fair bit of a contrarian call for us at this point in time as well.

briefs.current_title: Aberdeen亚太权益资产主管：印度盈利上修，外资回流时机已到？

subtitles.zh: 是的，回到财报季，我们在审视印度公司财报时，这次明显看到盈利上修和增长，这是多个季度以来首次，此前印度经历了较长时间的宏观挑战和通胀压力。
subtitles.en: Yes, so I think, and again, back to the earning season as we are in the midst of it, but as we go through the earnings of our Indian companies, I think what's standing out quite clear this time, which we have not seen for many quarters actu

subtitles.zh: 这次的关键变化是基本面改善，盈利真的开始回升。
subtitles.en: So this time, I think the key change is that we are seeing a change in fundamentals and earnings is really starting to come back.

subtitles.zh: 因此，鉴于外资此前大量流出印度，我们认为现在是重新加仓、挑选优质标的的好时机。
subtitles.en: And therefore, we do think that as foreigners have gone out of India for quite a fair bit, it is a good time to be adding back and picking up the quality stocks that we like.

subtitles.zh: 你可能会问我们看好哪些方向。首先金融板块是一个不错的切入点。
subtitles.en: You might ask us what are the stocks that we like. Starting with the financials, it is a good place to play.

subtitles.zh: 估值仍相对有吸引力，也经历了估值重估。虽然比中国内地的银行贵，但增长也更高。
subtitles.en: The valuation remains relatively attractive. It has gone through a deal rating as well. Yes, it's going to be more expensive than Chinese banks, but growth is also going to be higher.
